THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER ARTICLE 215 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA READ WITH SECTIONS 11 AND 12 OF THE CONTEMPT OF COURTS ACT PRAYING TO INITIATE CONTEMPT OF COURT PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE ACCUSED PERSONS AND FURTHER PLEASE TO PUNISH THE ACCUSED PERSONS FOR HAVING BEEN COMMITTED CONTEMPT OF THIS HONBLE COURT BY DISOBEYING THE ORDER PASSED IN WP NO.10523/2023 DATED 19.06.2023 WHICH IS PRODUCED AT ANNEXURE-A TO THE PETITION.
 THIS CCC COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY, CHIEF JUSTICE MADE THE FOLLOWING:

2  ORDER

The affidavit filed on behalf of the Accused/Respondent - Sri. Binjoy B K-, SLAO, Ramanagara and Mandya Distrct, clearly indicates that the order of the learned Single Judge is duly complied with and the Complainants are duly awarded with enhanced compensation and the same is already disbursed to them.
Copies of the receipts for having received the award being acknowledged by the Complainants are collectively available at Annexure-R3 to the said Affidavit.
In view of the above, this complaint of contempt is disposed off.

Sd/-
CHIEF JUSTICE Sd/-
